title: Due Board
user: A sole proprietor or household-sized business that needs a clean view of incoming supplier invoices, due dates, and manual payment status before cash arrives.
smallest_useful_product: An offline due-date board with supplier, amount, due date, attachment, paid date, and a weekly printable list. Non-goals: bank connections, bill payment, OCR, accounting journal entries, and credit scoring.
success_measure: At least 75% of pilots enter ten bills in the first month and can account for every due/paid status in a weekly review without opening their inbox.
monetization: free — a no-account local utility is a credible acquisition wedge; optional export/templates can later be paid.
constraints: Dates/time zones must be unambiguous; attachments stay local; provide data export and a deletion path; no financial advice or payment guarantees.
why_distinct: It intentionally stops at bill awareness and payment recording instead of recreating full accounts payable software.
